summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal and returning that result; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title) (the wrapper already has set_title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Non-terminal dropping already happens in Console._render_buffer, so no change was needed there. Tests were not run, per instructions; formatting was checked by reading only.
